verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only read-side operations that span many items: search across a folder hierarchy or a whole drive, and delta queries that track changes to an item and all its children without a full re-read. None of it documents acting on many items in one operation, such as batch requests or bulk copy, move, delete or permission changes. The only mutation endpoints cited work on a single item or file. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk request mechanism, bulk mutation operations (move/copy/delete/share across many items), and any hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
